title: Roger Penrose: Physics of Consciousness and the Infinite Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #85
summary: Lex Fridman interviews physicist Roger Penrose on consciousness, the limits of computation, quantum mechanics and his cyclic cosmology. It covers his views on AI and the big bang.
why: HN recommends it as an accessible walkthrough of Penrose's ideas on consciousness and cosmology, interesting even if debatable.

quote.text: Penrose delivered a very accessible walkthrough of his historical and current thoughts on the topic.
